To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the UWB master can transmit in the 5 GHz band with negligible interference to the FWA system, (2) the UWB slave can transmit at the same time as the FWA in the 5.2-5.8 GHz band with negligible impact on the FWA performance.

(i) the UWB master can coexist with an outdoor FWA system, without causing any harmful interference, if it is placed at least at 10m distance from the FWA antenna and if its power is reduced by at least 30dB; (ii) if UWB master is placed within 10m from the FWA system, the power of UWB master should be reduced by at least by 50dB to avoid harmful interference.
UWB can coexist with fixed wireless access (FWA) in the same frequency band.
